sec.title: August 28 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 276)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 28** across American network radio and syndication, John Hix investigating the 1855 Devonshire 'Devil's Footprints' phenomenon on *Strange As It Seems*, James Meighan busting counterfeit postage stamps on *Special Agent*, Ben Grauer celebrating 30 years of WNBC broadcasting history, post-war synthetic chemistry on *Living 1949*, Sigrid Schultz reporting from Berlin on the eve of World War II, and John W. Vandercook analyzing Mediterranean air raids (1936–1952):
